thesis: The speaker attributes audience growth to relevant experience, writing, transparency, and favorable platform timing.
summary: The interview describes building an audience by sharing actual business experience and developing strong copy. The participant says writing comes readily to him, while acknowledging the difficulty of tolerating judgment. He also says similar posts attracted far more followers in 2021 than later, explicitly crediting timing. Sharing business details is presented as both an exposure risk and a source of trust, friendships, customers, and mentors. This is a retrospective account of his creator strategy; it does not establish a general growth formula or prove that transparency is appropriate for every business.
